gauge.note: An independent slice of REVOTT, anchored by its own Ztp. It is not derived from any other instance and stands on its own gauge. The corpus carries a named reading END_IE_PURPOSE_CIRCUMSPECTION.100D over the same positions; whether this slice and that reading are the same object is not established here.

sampled.why: Instantiated across the whole key domain. No real-world targets are attached and none are claimed.

relations.note: Observed separations between sibling slices, recorded because they are exact, not because any slice defines another.

unresolved.year_to_instant: The gauge fixes Ztp as a decimal year, 2032.0638…, not as an instant. REVOTT's year-to-instant convention is not in the files read here, so this epoch and its time of day were calibrated against the slice whose Ztp/instant pair is known. Supply the native convention and the epoch is set directly from 2133667/1050.
